consequence.statement: Kyverno controllers lose the wildcard view permission; this does not affect admission, but it may affect reports and mutate/generate policies on custom resources because the controller may no longer be able to view those custom resources.
consequence.remediation: Check the RBAC section of the Kyverno documentation and give the controllers view access to any custom resources that your mutate/generate policies or reports rely on.

assertion.statement: Kyverno 1.13 removes the controllers' wildcard view permission and binds them to the default `view` role instead. Reports and mutate/generate policies on custom resources may be affected because the controllers may no longer be able to view those custom resources.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: The evidence names the affected groups only loosely (reports; mutate/generate policies on custom resources) and never says which resource kinds lose access compared with the default view role, so no precise predicate can be written.
